trust_decision.summary: Whether stored, client-influenced serialized data may be turned back into PHP objects: decided nowhere at the pinned commit. The widget-area setter stores any non-array value verbatim, and the shared BcUtil::unserialize() restores any class, on both the base64 path and the legacy raw path.

landing_point.why: The summary names the widget-area entity. _setWidgets passes a string 'widgets' value straight through (line 101), and _getWidgetsArray unserializes it (line 63).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /baser/api/admin/bc-widget-area/widget_areas/add and /edit/{id} (Api/Admin/WidgetAreasController::add/edit -> WidgetAreasService::create/update -> patchEntity), plus admin form add; read back by BcWidgetAreaHelper on front pages
fix_sites.module_kind: ORM entity mutator (write side, plugin bc-widget-area)

fix_sites.entry_point: public static API BcUtil::unserialize(), used by WidgetArea::_getWidgetsArray, BlogContentsTable::constructEyeCatchSize and the admin search-index template's content_types read
fix_sites.module_kind: shared core utility (lower-level API, plugin baser-core)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the widget-area entity, so sanitising _setWidgets looks complete. BcUtil::unserialize is a core utility in another package, and its raw-unserialize fallback is labelled temporary v3 back-compat (BcUtil.php:746), so a solver can argue it belongs to the core, not to the widget-area flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate array and scalar data must still round-trip, on both the base64 path and the legacy raw serialize() path. An already-serialized base64 string posted by the API edit (controller test expects it re-serialized) must still save. Over-broad fixes that drop the raw fallback, reject strings, or require is_array break the search-index content_types (fixture stores raw serialize(['Page'])) and the blog eye_catch_size readers.

O6_input_shapes: raw (non-base64) serialized object string via legacy fallback (BcUtil.php:748)
object nested inside a serialized array (fix.diff:51-53, fix.diff:134-135)
array value containing objects passed to the setter (fix.diff:66, fix.diff:94-104)
non-string, non-array value to the setter (fix.diff:79-81)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A key-value reader that auto-unserializes stored site_config values with raw unserialize() instead of BcUtil
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: site_configs already holds BcUtil-serialized values (content_types, BcSearchIndexManagerBehavior.php:275), and SiteConfigsService::update saves any posted key (SiteConfigsService.php:118-146), so a convenience decode in the key-value layer is a natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second, local unserialize of eye_catch_size, e.g. a legacy-format fallback that calls unserialize() directly
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same back-compat concern as BcUtil.php:746 applies to old blog rows, and a maintainer could inline it next to the reader.

O9_family: CWE-502 PHP object injection (unsafe unserialize of stored client-controlled data)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make WidgetArea::_setWidgets reject non-array strings (or add allowed_classes only to the base64 call), leaving the raw-unserialize fallback at BcUtil.php:748 and the other BcUtil::unserialize readers open.
